messages:
marta: kicking off intake for pelorus-8b-ct (context-tuned). goal = RAG chat + embeddings in prod. planning for hosted + dedicated + private. who wants ownership for evals, perf, and rollout?
kevin: i can own perf/infra. will baseline on 4k & 2k seq today. need expected p95/p99 targets.
anita: i'll run the eval suite and regression checks. which eval sets? production RAG prompts? safety tests?
marta: yes — use /shared/evals/rag-prod-2026 and embeddings-bench-3. include safety and hallucination probes. regression tolerance: quality delta < 2% (primary metrics), but call out individual prompt regressions > 5%.
sree: i'll handle quant experiments. plan: int8 + kv-cache enabled, compare with fp16 and a fallback fp16-qa variant. note: long-context behavior is key.
marta: draft checklist: 
• prepare eval dataset + baselines :anita
• perf baseline runs (2k/4k) :kevin
• quant matrix (fp16/int8/int4) :sree
• smoke and safety probes :anita
• rollout plan with canaries and traffic ramp :marta/kevin

marta: proposed canary config (initial percentages):
```yaml
route: pelorus-8b-ct
canary:
  hosted: 2%
  dedicated: 5%
  private: 1%
fallback: pelorus-8b-ct-fp16
metrics:
  latency_p95_ms: 200
  quality_regression_pct: 1.5
```
kevin: infra notes — prewarm plan and autoscale snippet:
```json
{"autoscale": {"min_replicas": 4, "max_replicas": 32, "cpu_target": 0.7}}
```
kevin: will pre-warm 8 gpus for initial canary and ensure KV cache warmup hooks run. also add warmup for embeddings workers.
marta: traffic ramp (suggested): 2 -> 5 -> 10 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100 with 10m observation windows. simple script: 
```bash
# ramp_traffic.sh
for p in 2 5 10 25 50 100; do
  curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rollout -d '{"route":"pelorus-8b-ct","percent":'"$p"'}'
  sleep 600
done
```
deploy-bot: Canary created for pelorus-8b-ct id=canary-2059006789 :rocket:
anita: quick eval update: initial run vs baseline -> BERTScore delta about -0.6% avg, BLEURT shows -0.9. a few long-context prompts had larger drops (~3-5%). attaching artifacts to the ticket.
sree: quant update: int8 + kv-cache reduces cost by ~2.6x but shows accuracy drop on 8k contexts. int4 currently fails on kv cache invalidation, reproducer: `kv_cache_mismatch` in logs. workaround param `kv_cache_compat=true` reduces failures but still shaky.
kevin: infra found spike in p99 during int8 warmup, likely cache miss storms. adding a throttling policy: if p95 > 2x baseline -> cut hosted traffic to 0 and route to dedicated only, notify oncall.
marta: rollout/rollback rules (proposed):
• auto-rollback if quality_regression_pct > 2.0 over 30m window OR any high-severity safety test fails
• if latency_p95 > 2x baseline -> pause hosted and route to dedicated; escalate to oncall after 5m
• manual rollback button for owners with changelog required

anita: opening ticket: https://issues.redwood/pelorus-2059 with eval artifacts and CSVs. will tag owners and attach example prompts that regressed.
sree: next steps for quant: try int8 + small per-layer fp16 fallback for KV-heavy layers, re-run eval set after fix.
kevin: I'll schedule the canary for 11:30 PT, will run the ramp script and watch dashboards. setting alert: quality_regression_pct > 1% AND trending up for 3 checks -> page.
marta: thanks all — i'll prepare the rollout doc and add the exact checklist to ops-runbooks. ping here when canary starts. :white_check_mark:
kevin: ack.
anita: ack, uploading artifacts now.
sree: ack, will push quant experiment logs to s3://redwood-temp/pelorus/2059
deploy-bot: Canary canary-2059006789 moved to state=running
marta: perfect. keep updates short in this thread, call if anything critical. :phone:
kevin: noted. monitoring window open.
anita: will post summary after 30m of traffic.
sree: working on int8 fix, will update if we can stabilize before 25% ramp.
